manual_splits.en: Ah... on my travel list, number one, cage diving with great white sharks; number two, hitchhiking across America from New York to San Francisco; number three, touring overland in Africa, and number four is climbing Mount Qomolangma, which, let’s be honest, I need to think twice.
zh: 我的旅行清单上，第一项是在防护笼里潜水，近距离接触大白鲨；
第二项是搭便车横穿美国，从纽约到旧金山；
第三项是在非洲进行陆路旅行；
第四项是攀登珠穆朗玛峰，不过说实话，这一项我得三思。
manual_splits.evidence: 四项旅行清单各成一屏，第三项不与第二项或珠峰项交叉；最后let’s be honest/think twice保留在珠峰项。 仅通过分屏语义预审，几何及实际换屏音证另核。

sentences.en: Now, Jim, you said a gap year can be just a few months?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，您刚才说，间隔年也可以只有几个月？

sentences.en: So what if people don’t want to take a whole year out?
sentences.zh: 那如果有人不想拿出整整一年呢？

w.m: phr. 暂时抽出整整一年

sentences.en: Well, everyone gets confused when you say gap year. They’re like, “What? It’s a whole year?” No, it’s not.
sentences.zh: 一说到间隔年，大家就容易误解。他们会说：“什么？是整整一年吗？”不，不是的。

w.m: phr. 感到困惑；产生误解

sentences.en: A gap year is just time-out between life stages.
sentences.zh: 间隔年只是人生两个阶段之间的一段暂歇。

sentences.en: People from all ages and all backgrounds take a gap year.
sentences.zh: 各个年龄、各种背景的人都可以过间隔年。

sentences.en: You know, and the majority of this time, I’d say it’s usually only for three to nine months?
sentences.zh: 而且，大多数时候，我想通常也就三到九个月。

sentences.en: Anyway, back to the question. If people only want to travel for a month or so, then there are a number of short gap options.
sentences.zh: 总之，回到刚才的问题。如果只想旅行一个月左右，也有很多短期的间隔年方案可选。

sentences.en: For example, they can travel around China or Southeast Asia, taking in the sights.
sentences.zh: 例如，可以环游中国或东南亚，欣赏各地风景。

sentences.en: They can volunteer in South America, and they can go on an overland tour in Africa.
sentences.zh: 可以去南美洲做志愿者，也可以在非洲进行陆路旅行。

sentences.en: There are endless opportunities out there.
sentences.zh: 机会多得数不清。

sentences.en: All you need to do is decide what it is you want to see and do.
sentences.zh: 你只需要决定自己想看什么、做什么。

sentences.en: Short gaps are like ultra-concentrated gap years.
sentences.zh: 短期间隔年就像高度浓缩版的间隔年。

sentences.en: Now, another question. You yourself travelled and volunteered in your gap year, so why is that a good option?
sentences.zh: 接下来还有一个问题。您在自己的间隔年中既旅行又做志愿者，为什么这是一个好选择？

sentences.en: Because you’re not only making a direct difference to local people’s lives, but you’re also learning more about a specific culture and society.
sentences.zh: 因为你不仅直接改变了当地人的生活，也能更深入地了解某个地区特有的文化和社会。

sentences.en: Often, you can learn a lot more about an area volunteering than just travelling around.
sentences.zh: 通常，相比单纯四处旅行，做志愿者能让你对一个地方有更深入的了解。

sentences.en: We’d love to find out what is on people’s travel list. Could you tell us yours?
sentences.zh: 我们很想知道大家的旅行愿望清单上都有什么。您能说说自己的吗？

sentences.en: I think a travel list has to be as ridiculous as possible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，旅行愿望清单就应该尽可能天马行空。

w.m: adj. 荒诞的；异想天开的

sentences.en: It has to be made up of things that are achievable and things that are perhaps unachievable.
sentences.zh: 其中既要有能够实现的事情，也要有一些或许实现不了的事情。

sentences.en: After all, what do you do when you’ve done everything.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果所有事情都做完了，你接下来还能做什么呢？

sentences.en: Ah... on my travel list, number one, cage diving with great white sharks; number two, hitchhiking across America from New York to San Francisco; number three, touring overland in Africa, and number four is climbing Mount Qomolangma, which, let’s be honest, I need to think twice.
sentences.zh: 我的旅行清单上，第一项是在防护笼里潜水，近距离接触大白鲨；第二项是搭便车横穿美国，从纽约到旧金山；第三项是在非洲进行陆路旅行；第四项是攀登珠穆朗玛峰，不过说实话，这一项我得三思。

sentences.en: So, Jim, you’ve travelled a huge amount for somebody who is only 26 years old.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，您才26岁，却已经去过这么多地方了。

sentences.en: I’m curious, how did you get the travel bug?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，您是怎么迷上旅行的？

sentences.en: Well, firstly, I grew up in an international household with a German mother and an Italian-American father, so our daily lives and conversations always were more global in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 首先，我在一个国际化家庭里长大，母亲是德国人，父亲是意大利裔美国人，因此我们的日常生活和交谈，在很多方面都更具全球视野。

w.m: adj. 意大利裔美国人的

sentences.en: Thus, I always saw the world as small and attainable.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我眼中，世界一直既小又触手可及。

w.m: adj. 可到达的；可实现的

sentences.en: Secondly, when I was 16, I left home to go to the United World College, which is a two-year boarding school with students from 90 different countries.
sentences.zh: 其次，16岁时，我离家去了世界联合学院；那是一所学制两年的寄宿学校，学生来自90个不同国家。

sentences.en: There, I really grew to see the entire world as an interconnected place, and began to think of myself less with national identities and more through global and human lenses.
sentences.zh: 在那里，我真正开始把整个世界看成相互联系的整体；我不再主要以国籍来定位自己，而是更多地从全球和人类整体的视角看待自己。

sentences.en: These two things really explain my love for the world and help to explain my love for travel, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想，这两件事确实能解释我为何热爱这个世界，也能解释我为何热爱旅行。

sentences.en: Oh, I see. And what will visiting every country in the world mean to you, personally?
sentences.zh: 噢，我明白了。那么，对您个人来说，走遍世界上每一个国家意味着什么？

sentences.en: For me, it'll be about how much I’ve learned.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，关键是看自己学到了多少。

sentences.en: It will be a validation of my ability to think critically and analyze the different ways that societies try to function.
sentences.zh: 这会检验我能否批判性地思考，并分析不同社会努力运作的各种方式。

sentences.en: There’s so much to learn from personal experience of being in a place.
sentences.zh: 身处某个地方的亲身经历中，有太多值得学习的东西。

sentences.en: And I love travel, because to me, it’s about constant learning.
sentences.zh: 我热爱旅行，因为对我而言，旅行意味着不断学习。

sentences.en: Yeah, “Travel broadens one’s mind,” as the saying goes.
sentences.zh: 正如那句俗话说的：“旅行开阔眼界。”

w.m: 谚语. 旅行开阔眼界

sentences.en: Well, Jim, thank you very much for joining us on the interview.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，非常感谢您参加我们的访谈。

w.m: phr. 参与某人的活动或节目

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

w.m: 交际用语. 我的荣幸；不客气
